description: Create a new KMS key. Supports AES256 (symmetric), RSA2048 (asymmetric), and ECDSA key types.

isConvergent.description: Enable convergent encryption (only for AES256, default: false)

keyName.description: Key name (3-15 chars, alphanumeric + '-' + '_', must start with letter)

protectionType.description: Key storage type: BASIC (encrypted internal storage) or COMMON_HSM (Hardware Security Module)

rotationPeriod.description: Auto rotation period in days (1-730, default: 90). Only when isAutoRotation is true

name: ncloud_kms_create_key
